response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled full-stack and DLang engineer, but he does not meet the core requirements for this specific C++ Capital Markets position. He lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development on Windows, possessing only brief professional C++ experience from 2014-2015. Additionally, he does not have the required enterprise database experience (SQL Server/Oracle) or the necessary domain expertise in Fixed Income or Investment Banking.
strengths: Over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience, including architecture and full-stack development.
Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, test-driven development, and DevOps practices.
Possesses some financial sector exposure through his previous work at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Critically lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ experience, with only 7 months of professional C++ listed over 9 years ago.
Missing required domain expertise in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Fixed Income.
Lacks mandatory experience with Windows platform development and enterprise SQL databases like SQL Server or Oracle.
